features.label: Reviewed feature
features.calculationScope: exact source/window or named signal scope

observations.text: Reviewed statement describing only what the measurements support.

learnerTask.observePrompt: What can you establish from these measurements?
learnerTask.investigatePrompt: What evidence would best discriminate between the remaining explanations?
learnerTask.takeaway: State the evidence lesson without converting association into root cause.

supportedConclusions: One or more conclusions directly supported by the selected measured evidence.
unsupportedConclusions: One or more tempting conclusions the selected evidence does not establish.
limitations: Study, sampling, context and generalisation limitations.

novelty.learningObjective: specific evidence skill this case adds to the library

reviewerId: stable reviewer identity or review-system identity
